name: browse-stress-open
description: Open-loop browse workload targeting productcatalogservice (high fan-in: frontend, checkoutservice, recommendationservice all call it). Fires GET /product/{sku} at a fixed rate regardless of backend latency. Open-loop analogue of post-cart-stress-open, used for the alt-service AS1 scenario where the fault sits on productcatalogservice. Uses pool_size 5000 to bound client memory under retry storms.
